retraction.reason: Retracted in M21: the Congress met on 29 May 1915 to elect a president for the remainder of Manuel de Arriaga’s term, three days after he resigned. It has a good incoming argument — the rising of 14 May brought the resignation about — but nothing argued leads out of it, and the two-edges bar wants one outgoing. What the interim presidency did was hold the ring until the June elections, which is sequence rather than consequence.
